comment_data.body: I think it is a good opportunity to make `revert_cr` more robust: it should not override already present buffer-local mapping. This should fix both Neovim>=0.13 new Cmdwin fail and possible future not related ones. Should also probably improve both quickfix and cmdwin tests to test that this does not override a buffer-local mapping.

comment_data.body: Why the move? The logic here is that this behavior is enabled in `setup()`, not in `start`. Using `'setup()'` test set is the common pattern to test autocommands that are created in `setup()`.

comment_data.body:
Ah, that's because of the autocommand order. The`FileType qf` autocommand for `revert_cr` is created during `setup()`. If it is before `FileType qf nnoremap ...` from test, then it "can't see" the buffer-local mapping as it is not yet created. Reloading the module creates the `revert_cr` autocommand after the test's one, so it *can* no see it.

Let's leave the `reload_module()` for now. It will become obsolete after #1818 (which I do want to implement sooner rather than later), as the default key will be `sj`.

comment_regular_data.body: This should now be part of the `main` branch as a regular `fix(jump2d)` and not necessarily a reaction to the Nightly change (which now would not fail the previous tests as `<CR>` is no longer a buffer-local mapping).
